description: Verify that the IPv4-Address field of the IPv4 Endpoint Option is local IP (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Endpoint Option: IPv4-Address == local IP.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's IPv4-Address field == local IP.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
IPv4-Address on the wire equals local IP.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_ipv4 — IPv4 endpoint address not DUT iface IP
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Endpoint Option IPv4-Address = local IP — normal
verdicts.Fail_ipv4: IPv4 endpoint address not DUT iface IP
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
